## Documented bridge exceptions

Every other bridge row above is transitional: it disappears when
its file is wired to static imports. The files below are bridge-fed
by decision, not by omission — each entry names the ADR that records
the decision. This section is the one part of the map that is not
derived from source: an exception is a decision, and a decision
cannot be derived. The registry lives in `scripts/module-map.mjs`
(BRIDGE_EXCEPTIONS); everything in each file's table row above
stays derived as before.

- `js/061-gbooks-key.js` — ADR-014: Wiring its bridge reads into static imports would close an import cycle: `060-metadata.js` imports seedTropes from this file, while this file resolves normalizeVolume (from `060-metadata.js`), apiFetch (from `050-helpers.js`), track (from `065-analytics.js`), and autoDetectAxes, TROPE_FORMAT_JUNK and bookGenres (from `020-ratings.js`) through the bridge at call time.
  The exception lapses when seedTropes moves out of this file, `060-metadata.js` stops importing from it, or phase 4 reshapes the import graph — the file then joins the normal per-file wiring pattern and this entry is removed.
